changed: Codex review round 7 on H4, three findings fixed with regression tests: compose stop/start/restart/pause/unpause targets come from a read-only daemon query by project label (names outside the allowed list or a failed query ask), replacing the line-based compose file scan; docker with another HOME or under sudo/doas/su/runuser/pkexec asks.

rulings.ruling: The hook runs a read-only docker ps query with the project label filter before a compose lifecycle change
rulings.cost_if_wrong: up to 10 s added to such a command; a failed query asks the owner

rulings.ruling: Docker under sudo asks even for read-only commands
rulings.cost_if_wrong: one owner prompt for sudo docker ps, which is rare on macOS
